'''Thulpin Agriculture''' was the largest agriculture corporation on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Draenell's Point]]. It was based in [[Thulpin City]], on the [[Mee'r]] continent,<ref name="GK" /> and handled the distribution of the planet's crops for the hundreds of independent [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] posed as a [[Galactic Sales Representative]] for Thulpin Agriculture. During a conversation with an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Food Inspector]], the agent learned of a pending Imperial project in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]], which was discovered to be the construction of the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]].<ref name="CTB">{{WEGCite|story=Changing the Balance|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Kit}}</ref>
